_about: RemoteMouseFix gameplay configuration: absolute correction starts immediately. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_target_ini_section: Read the target from [Playing] in RemoteMouseFix.ini beside the EXE, supporting a filename or full executable path.
_high_res_smoothing_timer: Use 16ms high-resolution waitable timer, with WM_TIMER fallback if unsupported. Validated in A/B profile, enabled for Playing trial.
